title: Fourier Support Implies Relevance
statement: Let $f:\\{−1,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$, let $S$ be a set of coordinates, and let $i\\in S$. If the Fourier coefficient of $f$ indexed by $S$ is nonzero, then $f$ has positive influence at coordinate $i$.
